description: This file defines the HiveDelegationTokenProvider class, which manages delegation tokens for Hive within Spark, including token acquisition, security checks, and user context handling.

classes.name: HiveDelegationTokenProvider
classes.description: A class that provides Hive delegation tokens for Spark, handling token retrieval, security checks, and user context.

methods.name: serviceName
methods.description: Returns the service name 'hive' for delegation token purposes.

methods.name: hiveConf
methods.description: Creates a HiveConf object from Hadoop configuration, with fallback on failure.

methods.name: delegationTokensRequired
methods.description: Determines if delegation tokens are needed based on Spark and Hadoop security configurations.

methods.name: obtainDelegationTokens
methods.description: Obtains Hive delegation tokens and adds them to credentials.

methods.name: doAsRealUser
methods.description: Executes a function as the real logged-in user, handling proxy users.

methods.name: tokenAlias
methods.description: Returns the Text key used for Hive server2 delegation tokens.
